crew.overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
crew.title: Donnie Darko

crew.overview: Henry is a player skilled at seducing women. But when this veterinarian meets Lucy, a girl with a quirky problem when it comes to total recall, he realizes it's possible to fall in love all over again…and again, and again. That's because the delightful Lucy has no short-term memory, so Henry must woo her day after day until he finally sweeps her off her feet.
crew.title: 50 First Dates

details.biography: Nancy Juvonen (born May 18, 1967) is an American film producer. She and Drew Barrymore own the production company Flower Films. Juvonen married comedian Jimmy Fallon, host of The Tonight Show, on December 22, 2007. They have two daughters born in 2013 and 2014.
details.name: Nancy Juvonen
